column1: # Measured cost, in seconds, of the full-tier steps of ci/sections.yml `workspace-test-shard`
# that do not cost the same on every shard (#5486). scripts/check_shard_balance.sh sums them
# per shard and refuses a predicted spread over its budget.
# Columns (TAB): step name, exactly as in ci/sections.yml | seconds | source
#   seconds: ONE number  = the step's cost on whichever shard runs it (a once-only step)
#            N numbers   = comma-separated, one per shard (a partitioned step)
# A step not listed here is assumed to cost the same on every shard.
# Source of every `measured` row: mean of the fat-driver `##[step N] success (Xs)` lines of
# the three shard jobs in six full-tier merge_group runs on main, 2026-10-17/18 (attempt 1):
